notes.title: Update 0.6.0.1 State Expansion
notes.notes:

- Territory required for state expansion:

"A" - private territory in all sectors of the state
"B" - the number of sectors of the state

notes.title: Update 0.6 States

- Added state
- Added new building "Castle"
- If the sector has the status of village or above, then in this sector you can create a state

- The player has the opportunity to leave the state in any status other than the ruler

Citizens' statuses:

Citizen - Basic actions are available in the state.
Freeman - Can take citizens to the state. Cannot be deprived of citizenship.
Manager - May appoint honorary citizens. May deprive of citizenship.
Ruler - All Functions Available

- When a state is created, it is assigned a random name
- You can change the name of the state in the "Castle" for 500 000 GC
- In the "Castle" is possible to see the rating of citizens (benefit to the state)
